modal.title: Pontus-X v1 migrates to v2
modal.text:
This portal and the Pontus-X v1 networks will be **switched off in December 2026**. After that, you will no longer be able to access assets, services or transactions on Pontus-X v1.

**Access will be limited to current projects, existing subscribers and participants running fully sovereign infrastructure.** Want to keep using Pontus-X v1 until the shutdown? [Contact deltaDAO to subscribe](https://www.delta-dao.com/contact).

**Using Pontus-X v1 to publish, consume or demo assets?** Please migrate to Pontus-X v2 before December to keep your services running without interruption.

[Explore Pontus-X v2](https://market.delta-dao.com) or [contact deltaDAO](https://www.delta-dao.com/contact) for more information and help with your migration.
